_about: Which OCCT service profile applies on each date (GTFS calendar + calendar_dates semantics). Shorter periods override longer ones. status=confirmed means OCCT itself announced it; status=provisional means the dates come from the Binghamton University academic calendar plus the pattern OCCT followed in prior years and the OCCT notice has not been posted yet — the API warns on those days. Dates outside every period get status=unknown.

alternate.warning: OCCT published an alternate schedule for this date; the regular timetable is shown and times may differ.

interim.empty_message: Only the ITC–Campus Shuttle runs during interim/break weeks (weekdays 8:00 AM–5:30 PM from Mohawk).

summer.empty_message: Summer service: only the Residential–ITC–UClub Shuttle runs, weekdays only.
